Global sales for the quarter topped analyst estimates and reached $9.7 billion, up 10% on an organic basis\ for the underlying base business\\. Reported sales decreased 18.1% due to the anticipated decline in COVID-19 testing revenue versus the previous year. Abbott’s adjusted diluted earnings per share was $1.03 (GAAP diluted EPS was $0.75), beating analyst estimates. [...] # Abbott Delivers Q1 Results

## Growth in base business and a diverse  ,portfolio create momentum for 2023.  ,

Apr. 19, 2023

Copy Link   Share on X   Share on Facebook   Share on Linkedin

At the close of the first quarter of 2023, Abbott’s latest financial results indicate growth fueled by the performance of its base business. [...] Solid growth in Medical Devices – 12.4% organic (8.5% reported) – was driven by double-digit organic sales growth in Structural Heart, Heart Failure, Neuromodulation and Diabetes Care. One key standout: Sales of the world-leading FreeStyle Libre continuous glucose monitoring portfolio grew approximately 50% in the U.S. and reached $1.3 billion globally.
